summary: Frontend-only regression for 6 bug fixes (WOB relabel, WOB formula, WOB warnings, Friction Reducer input/output/warnings). Used demo Pro session cookie against preview URL. 5 of 6 bug groups PASS; 2 defects found: (a) metric-daN inputs are NOT being converted to Imperial in formulas.grab() due to a case-sensitivity bug, so WOB (and other force calcs) in Metric are wrong (~44% low); (b) Annular_Frac is missing the 'FR friction reduction' result row that the spec required (Frac_Through_CT has it, Annular_Frac does not).

ui_bugs.issue: Case-sensitivity bug — label is lowercased to l='...(dan)' but check is l.includes('(daN)'). Same defect for any other Mixed-case unit token. Result: daN inputs (Weight on gauge – tagged, Run-in-hole weight, Overpull, Shift Force, Fish Wt, Jar Overpull, String Drag) are NOT converted to lb. In Metric CT_Milling with defaults tagged=8010 daN, RIH=8680 daN the WOB result shows 298 daN instead of expected ~670 daN. Imperial mode is unaffected (WOB=1500 lb correct).

Missing 'FR friction reduction' result row. Spec requires this row on Annular_Frac too (Frac_Through_CT already appends it via fr_savings_pct). Verified in UI: on Annular_Frac tab with FR entered, 'FR friction reduction' is absent from CALCULATED RESULTS. Note: friction pressure IS reduced by fr_factor correctly, only the display row is missing.

action_items: FIX A (HIGH): In /app/frontend/src/lib/formulas.js grab(), replace `if (l.includes("(daN)"))` with `if (l.includes("(dan)"))` (or use `label.toLowerCase().includes(...)` with lowercase token). Same applies to any other mixed-case token if added later. This will restore correct WOB in Metric on CT_Milling and CT_Drilling, and also fix Overpull/Shift-Force/Fishing calcs in Metric mode.

FIX B (MED): In calc_Annular_Frac, compute fr_savings_pct = fr_load>0 ? (1-fr_factor)*100 : null and push a result row: {label: 'FR friction reduction', value: fr_savings_pct.toFixed(0), unit: '%', note: 'Effective drag reduction from FR loading'} — mirroring calc_Frac_Through_CT.
critical_code_review_comments: grab() unit-hint checks in formulas.js should all use lowercase tokens because `l = label.toLowerCase()`. Recommend consolidating to a single {tokenLower: converter} map to prevent future regressions.

Friction Reducer numeric equivalence gpt ≡ L/m³ is correct (both 1×10⁻³ ratios), but consider adding a comment above the grab() usage in calc_Sand_Cleanout to prevent future contributors from double-converting.
Consider adding data-testid to sheet-tab buttons and to input rows (currently no data-testid on tabs or inputs — tests had to fall back to text/row lookups).

context_for_next_testing_agent: PASS items verified in this run: CT_Milling & CT_Drilling parameter relabel (no more Surface Wt/Up Weight, now Weight on gauge – tagged & Run-in-hole weight, correct units per unit system); WOB formula label 'WOB = RIH weight − Weight on gauge (tagged)'; WOB=1500 lb in Imperial with defaults 18000/19500 (correct); negative-WOB warning fires when tagged>RIH ('Negative WOB — tagged weight exceeds run-in-hole weight. Recheck inputs...'); >2000 lb sinusoidal-buckling warning fires; Friction Reducer input present on Sand_Cleanout / Frac_Through_CT / Annular_Frac with correct units (gpt / L/m³) and default 1.5 / 2.0; 'FR volume per bottoms-up' result present on Sand_Cleanout; 'FR friction reduction' present on Frac_Through_CT with values 73% @1.5gpt → 100% @0gpt (Pf went 2994→4129 psi confirming friction correctly rises without FR); low-FR (<0.5) and high-FR (>4.0 on Sand_Cleanout) warnings fire. Metric default unit system PASS. Remaining fails: metric-daN conversion bug (WOB shows 298 daN vs expected 670 daN in metric mode), and missing FR friction reduction row on Annular_Frac.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/lib/formulas.js function grab(values, params, unitSystem, patterns): the line `const l = label.toLowerCase();` lowercases the label, but the subsequent unit-hint check `if (l.includes("(daN)"))` searches for the uppercase-N literal token in a lowercased string, so it never matches. The daN→lb converter never runs; raw daN values are returned as-is and treated as lb by downstream imperial math. In fmt('force', met) the value is then converted back lb→daN using 1/2.24809, producing a value ≈44.5% of the correct magnitude (670 daN raw → mis-interpreted → displayed as 298 daN). Fix is a one-character change: `l.includes("(dan)")`. Reproduction: open CT_Milling in Metric with default inputs 8010/8680; WOB reads 298 daN. Expected 670 daN (or convert 8680−8010=670 daN → 1500 lb → back to daN 670).
